concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one polished macOS app icon concept for UltraScale, a small native utility for adjusting HiDPI scaling on ultrawide monitors. Single icon, square composition, centered rounded-square macOS icon tile on a quiet neutral light gray background with ample margin, no words or letters, no numbers, no watermark, not an Apple logo. Purpose: understandable at small Dock sizes, elegant restrained geometry, strong simple silhouette, premium subtle material and lighting. This is a visual candidate, not a comparison board. Concept A: a deep midnight-blue rounded-square tile containing a crisp luminous cyan ultrawide monitor outline with a small discreet stand, and one horizontal scaling slider beneath the screen, white slider thumb. The wide monitor shape is the central recognizable motif. Blue-cyan palette, precise and calm, restrained depth, avoid excessive glow, front view.
